questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: Ragini plays the guitar with a melody.
Ragini plays the guitar with melodiousness.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'melodiously'** is the correct adverb to **describe how Ragini plays the guitar.**
 
• Adjectives describe nouns, while adverbs describe verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
 
 
• Example: **"She sings beautifully." **('beautifully' is an adverb describing the verb 'sings')
 
• Using the correct form of words ensures clarity and precision in communication.
 
• Example: "He is a quick runner." ('quick' is an adjective describing the noun 'runner')
 
• "He runs** quickly.**" ('quickly' is an adverb describing the verb 'runs')​
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is **"*Ragini plays the guitar melodiously."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other options either use incorrect forms or do not make grammatical sense:
 
 
• Option 1:** "with a melody" is not how we typically describe playing an instrument.**
 
• Option 3: **"with melodiousness" is awkward and uncommon.**
 
• Option 4: **"melodious" is an adjective, not an adverb.**

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four parts. Identify the part that contains an error.

(A) I am hearing / (B) that the heat wave / (C) is going to be / (D) worse this year.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the phrase 'I am hearing' is incorrect.
 
• In English, the verb **'hear'** is **stative** and is not used in the continuous form.
 
• Instead of **'I am hearing'**, we should use **'I hear'** to indicate perception through the sense of hearing.
 
 
• **Example:** ***I hear** that the meeting is postponed*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be 'I hear'.

 Hence, the correct statement is: ***I hear that the heat wave is going to be__ worse this year*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stative verbs** describe a state rather than an action and are generally not used in the continuous form.

 
 
• **Example:** ***I believe** in fair play*.
 
 
 
• **Common stative verbs** include: *believe, know, understand, belong, contain, consist, love, hate*, etc.
 
 
• Example: ***I understand** your concerns*.

questions.question: Select the option with the correct use of future tense.

options.text: I hope your health is getting better by next week.
I hope your health will get better by next week.
I hope your health have been getting better by next week.
I hope your health is get better by next week.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Future Tense: **The phrase** "will get better" **correctly uses **the future tense **to describe **an improvement in health that is expected to happen by next week.**
 
• **Verb Agreement:** The future tense is formed by using** "will"** before the base form of the verb, which in this case is **"get."**
 
• **Clarity of Intention:** Using **"will**" shows a clear intention or expectation of future improvement, which aligns with the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Context Appropriateness:** The context of the sentence is about something expected to happen in the future, making** "will get better"** the most appropriate choice.
 
• **Hope and Expectation:** The phrase** "I hope"** sets the expectation, and** "will get better"** fits logically as it refers to a future event that is hoped for.
 
• **Common Usage:** This construction is commonly used in English to express hope for future improvements or changes.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Uses present continuous tense **"is getting,"** which is incorrect for a future expectation.
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect usage of **"have been getting,"** which is present perfect continuous tense, not appropriate for future hope.
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect grammar as **"is get" **doesn't form a valid verb phrase.

3 units = 12 years ⇒ 1 unit = 4 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 years.**

2 years hence: 2 × (M + 2) = 4 × (S + 2)

questions.solution:

Sum of angles in a triangle = 180º

**Calculation:**

Let the smallest angle be x º.

Largest angle = x + 42 º

Remaining angle = x + 24° 

Sum of angles: x + (x + 42) + (x + 24) = 180 º

⇒ 3x = 180 - 66

⇒ 3x = 114

• The success of ENIAC demonstrated the potential of electronic computing and paved the way for the development of future computers.
 
• ENIAC's architecture and design principles influenced many subsequent computer designs.
 
• Despite its size and power consumption, ENIAC marked the beginning of the electronic computing era and had a profound impact on science, engineering, and technology.

questions.question: Electrochemical cell is a device which converts chemical energy into electrical energy in a/an _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**indirect redox reaction**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An electrochemical cell is a device that converts **chemical energy into electrical energy **through an **indirect redox reaction**.
 
• In an electrochemical cell, oxidation and reduction reactions occur in separate compartments, allowing the transfer of electrons through an external circuit.
 
• This separation of reactions helps in generating a potential difference that drives the flow of electrons, thus producing electrical energy.
 
• Examples of electrochemical cells include galvanic cells and batteries, which are widely used in various applications for power supply.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Redox reactions** involve the transfer of electrons between two species; **oxidation refers to the loss of electrons**, while** reduction refers to the gain of electrons**.
 
• In a **galvanic cell, the anode is the site of oxidation, and the cathode is the site of reduction**.
 
• The **electrolyte** in the cell facilitates the flow of ions, maintaining the charge balance as electrons move through the external circuit.
 
• Electrochemical cells are fundamental to the operation of batteries, fuel cells, and various types of sensors.

questions.question: Which of the following writs in Latin means ‘we command’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mandamus**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The writ of **Mandamus** in Latin means '**we command**'.
 
• It is** issued by a court to a public official, lower court, or government body to perform a duty they are obligated to complete**.
 
• Mandamus is one of the five writs under the Indian Constitution used to enforce the performance of public duties.
 
• This writ is a powerful tool to ensure that public authorities fulfil their duties as mandated by law.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other writs include **Habeas Corpus, Certiorari, Prohibition,** and **Quo Warranto**.
 
• **Habeas Corpus** is used to bring a person who has been detained unlawfully to court.
 
• **Prohibition** is issued by a higher court to a lower court to prevent it from exceeding its jurisdiction.
 
• **Certiorari** is issued to transfer a case from a lower court to a higher court for review.
 
• **Quo Warranto** is issued to challenge the legality of a person's claim to a public office.
 
• These writs are essential for the protection of fundamental rights and the enforcement of the rule of law.
